_doc: PENDING S3 payload-semantic conformance vectors — NOT YET WIRED. These describe the PER-OPCODE PAYLOAD vectors the S3 stories (F-03 HELLO/caps, F-16 version negotiation, F-22 SET_LABEL body, F-04 RUN{mode,path}/RUN_STATE) will pin in the SHARED cross-language corpus. They carry NO frame_hex on purpose: the byte encodings they depend on live in protocol.md §6 (Run/Console), §7 (HELLO/caps), and §9 (Versioning), which are STILL DRAFT (freeze ledger, 2026-07-01). Fabricating frame bytes here would REDEFINE draft wire — forbidden (wire is referenced, never redefined). Each entry states the frozen SEMANTIC obligation and the exact freeze it is BLOCKED on. When protocol.md §6/§7/§9 + the specs.md FR mirror freeze, firmware-test-author fills in field tuples + zlib-oracle frame_hex and promotes these into corpus.json (byte-identical guard for firmware pble_* and the Dart pble client).

_blocked_on.protocol.md_§6: RUN{mode,path} payload shape; RSP-then-RUN_STATE(running) sequence; running->done/error transitions; RUN_STATE state-enum byte values
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§7: HELLO{proto_versions[],app_name,app_version} + RSP{proto_version,caps} caps serialization; DEVICE_INFO/INFO payload encoding; SET_LABEL label body framing; device_id/label field encoding
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§9: accept-only-VER-0x01 negotiation wire; refuse-unsatisfiable-version wire; additive-caps rule
_blocked_on.specs.md_OI-6: SET_LABEL max byte-length freeze (architect froze PBLE_LABEL_MAX=24 in the native contract; the specs.md/protocol.md [docs] mirror has not landed)

pending_vectors.name: hello_rsp_caps_complete
pending_vectors.obligation: RSP{0x01} caps MUST contain every FR-INFO-3 field: chip, mpy_version, fs_root, max_file_size, put_window(W), chunk_size, has_sd, free_mem, device_id, label, has_identify, identify_led — typed per §7.

pending_vectors.name: device_info_rsp_fields
pending_vectors.obligation: RSP{0x02}/INFO-read MUST report chip, mpy_version, free_mem, fs_root, mtu, device_id, label (FR-INFO-1) and MUST be byte-identical to the INFO-characteristic read value (FR-INFO-4).

pending_vectors.name: hello_refuse_unsatisfiable_version
pending_vectors.obligation: HELLO offering only versions the agent cannot satisfy MUST be refused (not silently mis-spoken) — FR-INFO-5.

pending_vectors.name: decode_reject_ver_not_0x01
pending_vectors.obligation: A frame with VER != 0x01 MUST be rejected per the versioning policy — FR-PROTO-7. (VER byte is §3.1-frozen; the REFUSAL POLICY wording is §9-DRAFT.)

pending_vectors.name: set_label_body_persists_and_renames
pending_vectors.obligation: SET_LABEL{utf8<=PBLE_LABEL_MAX} stored to NVS, becomes advertised name + DEVICE_INFO.label; over-length -> ERANGE not stored; empty clears to PyBLE-XXXX — FR-IDENT-1/FR-BLE-12.

pending_vectors.name: run_file_lifecycle
pending_vectors.obligation: RUN{mode:file,path} -> RSP{OK} then RUN_STATE(running); normal end -> RUN_STATE(done); uncaught -> RUN_STATE(error); RUN while running -> EBUSY — FR-RUN-1/4/7/9.
